claims.text: The Millennium Bridge is a striking steel suspension bridge designed exclusively for pedestrians to cross the River Thames.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Although construction began in 1998, the bridge first opened to the public on 10 June 2000.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: It quickly earned the hilarious nickname of the 'Wobbly Bridge' after pedestrians experienced an alarming swaying motion on opening day.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Because of the swaying, it had to be closed for almost two years while engineers worked to stabilize the structure.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Before it could finally reopen in February 2002, 700 staff members had to walk across it to conduct real-life safety tests.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The bridge's perfect alignment provides a stunning, unobstructed terminating vista of the south façade of St Paul's Cathedral.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: If you look closely under your feet, the bridge is actually dotted with hundreds of tiny, hidden paintings that most people walk right past.
claims.subject: self
